I entered this store for the first time on April 29, 2026, to pick up an order. My first impression was good; the store seemed tidy, and I was thinking of recommending it to my mother for grooming services for our dog. But that impression quickly disappeared when I looked at the grooming area right at the entrance, which has a glass partition.
There was an employee grooming a large, brown dog, while a small dog, like a Yorkie, was in the bathtub completely soaked, shivering, waiting for who knows what or whom. It's not even hot today. I went in, and he was already there. I waited to be served, picked up the order, and left, and the dog stayed there in the bathtub, wet and shivering. What is the purpose of this? To let animals endure such a stressful moment? Very, very bad. If they don't have enough staff, they shouldn't schedule more than one animal at a time. I will not return to this store and I will never recommend it to anyone.
